summary: This bill establishes the Land Port of Entry Modernization Trust Fund, funded by a portion of customs and immigration fees, to finance the construction, expansion, improvement, and staffing of U.S. land ports of entry.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a trust fund to modernize land ports of entry, which are critical for border security and processing. It also proposes surcharges on immigrant user fees, land border inspection fees, and machine-readable visa fees, with a portion of these funds directed to the trust fund. These measures aim to enhance the infrastructure and staffing at the border, contributing to more secure and efficient border operations.
